calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.sqm,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.channel_code = 'ST' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as total_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE s.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.sqm
ORDER BY total_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.region,
  s.format,
  s.sqm,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.channel_code = 'ST' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) as net_sales_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE s.is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format, s.sqm
ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC
LIMIT 10
